genesis.22.p1.b1.text: Some time later God tested Abraham and said to him, “Abraham!”

genesis.22.p1.b3.text: Take your son, … your only son Isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering …

genesis.22.p2.b4.text: So Abraham got up early the next morning, saddled his donkey, and took along two of his servants and his son Isaac. He split the wood for a burnt offering …

genesis.22.p2.b5.text: On the third day Abraham looked up and saw the place in the distance.

genesis.22.p2.b6.text: Stay here with the donkey, … The boy and I will go over there to worship, and then we will return to you.

genesis.22.p3.b7.text: Abraham took the wood for the burnt offering and placed it on his son Isaac. He himself carried the fire and the sacrificial knife …

genesis.22.p3.b8.text: My father! … The fire and the wood are here, … but where is the lamb for the burnt offering?

genesis.22.p3.b9.text: God Himself will provide the lamb for the burnt offering, my son.

genesis.22.p3.b10.text: And the two walked on together.

genesis.22.p4.b11.text: When they arrived at the place God had designated, Abraham built the altar there and arranged the wood.

genesis.22.p4.b12.text: He bound his son Isaac and placed him on the altar, atop the wood.

genesis.22.p5.b13.text: Then Abraham reached out his hand and took the knife to slaughter his son.

genesis.22.p6.b16.text: Do not lay a hand on the boy or do anything to him, … for now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your only son from me.

genesis.22.p7.b17.text: Then Abraham looked up and saw behind him a ram in a thicket, caught by its horns.

genesis.22.p7.b18.text: So he went and took the ram and offered it as a burnt offering in place of his son.

genesis.22.p7.b19.text: And Abraham called that place The LORD Will Provide. So to this day it is said, “On the mountain of the LORD it will be provided.”

genesis.22.p8.b20.text: By Myself I have sworn, … I will multiply your descendants like the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore.

genesis.22.p8.b21.text: And through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice.

genesis.22.p8.b22.text: Abraham went back to his servants, and they got up and set out together for Beersheba. …

genesis.22.p9.b23.text: Milcah has also borne sons to your brother Nahor …

genesis.22.p9.b24.text: … and Bethuel. And Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. Milcah bore these eight sons to Abraham’s brother Nahor.

genesis.22.p9.b25.text: Moreover, Nahor’s concubine, whose name was Reumah, bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
